senses.en: a large solid piece of hard material
senses.pattern: a block of ice / a block of wood / concrete blocks
senses.example: The artist spent three weeks carving a huge [[block]] of marble into a sleeping lion.
senses.example_zh: 這位藝術家花了三週，把一大塊大理石雕成一頭沉睡的獅子。

senses.en: something that stops progress or clear thinking
senses.pattern: a mental block / a stumbling block / a block to progress
senses.example: Fear of making mistakes can be a major stumbling [[block]] for anyone learning to speak a foreign language.
senses.example_zh: 害怕犯錯，可能是任何人學說外語時的一大障礙。

gsat.sentence: Larger [[blocks]] of ice from Sweden are easier to handle for sculptors.
These large ice [[blocks]] are used for large ice sculpting events and for building ice hotels.

senses.en: to give in to pressure or someone's demands
senses.pattern: bow to pressure / bow to public opinion / bow to demands / bow to the inevitable
senses.example: After weeks of protests from parents, the school finally [[bowed]] to pressure and dropped the new fee.
senses.example_zh: 在家長抗議數週後，學校終於向壓力屈服，取消了這項新收費。

senses.en: a knot with two loops, used as decoration
senses.pattern: tie a bow / tie a ribbon in a bow / a bow in her hair / a red bow
senses.example: She wrapped the gift in gold paper and tied the ribbon in a neat [[bow]] on top.
senses.example_zh: 她用金色的紙把禮物包好，並在上面用緞帶打了個整齊的蝴蝶結。

senses.en: to remove unwanted things from a place
senses.pattern: clear the table / clear snow from the road / clear A of B
senses.example: Volunteers spent the whole weekend [[clearing]] fallen branches from the hiking trail after the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 颱風過後，志工花了整個週末清除登山步道上掉落的樹枝。

senses.en: to show officially that someone is not guilty
senses.pattern: be cleared of a crime / clear one's name / clear someone of all charges
senses.example: After a two-year investigation, the coach was finally [[cleared]] of cheating in the national tournament.
senses.example_zh: 經過兩年的調查，這位教練終於洗清了在全國錦標賽中作弊的嫌疑。

senses.en: to give or get official permission for something
senses.pattern: be cleared for takeoff / be cleared to land / clear customs
senses.example: The pilot waited on the runway for ten minutes before the plane was [[cleared]] for takeoff.
senses.example_zh: 飛行員在跑道上等了十分鐘，飛機才獲得批准起飛。

gsat.sentence: Moderate fires will [[clear]] the ground of competing plant life, and the rising heat dries and opens the ripe cones of the redwood, releasing many thousands of seeds onto the ground below.
To avoid this, scientists have devised several ways for [[clearing]] the sky.

senses.en: to give someone or something a blow or shock
senses.pattern: deal a blow to / deal a heavy blow / deal a fatal blow
senses.example: The long drought [[dealt]] a heavy blow to farmers who depended on rice for their income.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱給予仰賴稻米維生的農民沉重的打擊。

senses.en: to give out playing cards to the players
senses.pattern: deal the cards / deal a hand / deal sb five cards
senses.example: Grandpa shuffled the deck and [[dealt]] five cards to each of us before the game began.
senses.example_zh: 遊戲開始前，爺爺洗了牌，發給我們每人五張牌。

senses.en: very important to someone; greatly valued
senses.pattern: be dear to sb / dear to sb's heart / hold sth dear
senses.example: This old wooden piano is very [[dear]] to my mother because her father made it by hand.
senses.example_zh: 這架老舊的木製鋼琴對我母親來說非常珍貴，因為那是她父親親手做的。
senses.note: 常用 be dear to sb

senses.en: costing a lot of money; expensive
senses.pattern: far too dear / rather dear / get dearer
senses.example: Fresh vegetables have become so [[dear]] this winter that many families are buying frozen ones instead.
senses.example_zh: 今年冬天新鮮蔬菜變得很昂貴，許多家庭改買冷凍蔬菜。
senses.note: 主要為英式用法；副詞 dearly 代價慘重地

senses.en: to be spread over an area in many places
senses.pattern: dot the landscape / dot the coastline / be dotted with sth
senses.example: Small fishing villages [[dot]] the coastline, each with its own colorful harbor.
senses.example_zh: 一座座小漁村散布於海岸線上，各自擁有色彩繽紛的港口。
senses.note: 常用被動 be dotted with

senses.en: a slight advantage over other people
senses.pattern: a competitive edge / have an edge over / give sb an edge
senses.example: The company hopes its longer-lasting battery will give it an [[edge]] in the crowded electric scooter market.
senses.example_zh: 該公司希望續航力更長的電池，能讓它在競爭激烈的電動機車市場中取得優勢。

senses.en: to move slowly and carefully in one direction
senses.pattern: edge toward / edge closer / edge forward / edge one's way
senses.example: The frightened kitten slowly [[edged]] toward the bowl of milk, watching us the whole time.
senses.example_zh: 受驚的小貓朝那碗牛奶慢慢挪動，眼睛始終盯著我們。

gsat.sentence: In this way, these secret shoppers may help a business gain a competitive [[edge]].

senses.en: to put your name down for a contest or exam
senses.pattern: enter a contest / enter a competition / enter a race
senses.example: More than two hundred students [[entered]] the school's annual poster design competition this spring.
senses.example_zh: 今年春天有兩百多名學生報名參加學校一年一度的海報設計比賽。

senses.en: to begin a career or become involved in an activity
senses.pattern: enter the teaching profession / enter politics / enter the job market
senses.example: Many graduates [[enter]] the teaching profession hoping to make a difference in children's lives.
senses.example_zh: 許多畢業生懷著改變孩子人生的期望投身教職。

gsat.sentence: She was invited to [[enter]] an invention contest held by her school.

senses.en: the front or surface of something
senses.pattern: a clock face / the north face of a mountain / a rock face / the face of the earth
senses.example: The climbers spent two days on the steep north [[face]] of the mountain before reaching the top.
senses.example_zh: 登山隊在這座山陡峭的北面花了兩天才登頂。

senses.en: to be turned or pointed toward a direction
senses.pattern: face south / face the sea / face each other / a room facing the street
senses.example: Our classroom [[faces]] east, so the morning sun shines directly on the blackboard.
senses.example_zh: 我們的教室朝向東方，所以早晨的陽光會直接照在黑板上。

senses.en: the way something feels when you touch it
senses.pattern: the feel of / a soft feel / a smooth feel
senses.example: I love the [[feel]] of this old wool blanket; it is far softer than any new one.
senses.example_zh: 我很喜歡這條舊羊毛毯的觸感，它比任何新毯子都柔軟得多。

senses.en: the atmosphere or general character of a place
senses.pattern: a friendly feel / a modern feel / have the feel of
senses.example: With its wooden tables and soft lighting, the café has the cozy [[feel]] of a family kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館有木桌和柔和的燈光，散發出家庭廚房般的溫馨氛圍。

senses.en: to search for something using your hands
senses.pattern: feel for / feel around for / feel in one's pocket
senses.example: When the lights went out, Dad [[felt]] along the wall for the switch of the emergency lamp.
senses.example_zh: 停電時，爸爸沿著牆壁摸索緊急照明燈的開關。
senses.note: 過去式 felt；feel for＝摸索尋找

gsat.sentence: The [[feel]] of a book, the smell, the weight, and the knowledge that a particular book might be more than a hundred years old—all these highlight the importance of preserving the physical book as a complement to technology.

senses.en: a valuable or interesting thing or person discovered
senses.pattern: a real find / an important find / archaeological finds
senses.example: The ancient coins dug up near the temple were the most exciting [[find]] of the year.
senses.example_zh: 在廟宇附近挖出的古錢幣是今年最令人振奮的發現。

senses.en: (of a court) to decide officially that someone is guilty or not
senses.pattern: find someone guilty / find someone not guilty / be found guilty of theft
senses.example: After a two-week trial, the court [[found]] the company guilty of polluting the river.
senses.example_zh: 經過兩週的審理，法院判定該公司汙染河川罪名成立。

senses.en: to start an organization, school, or city
senses.pattern: found a company / found a school / be founded in 1920
senses.example: The two sisters [[founded]] a small publishing company that prints books by local writers.
senses.example_zh: 這對姐妹創立了一家小型出版社，專門印行本地作家的書。

senses.en: to base something on a belief, idea, or fact
senses.pattern: be founded on trust / be founded on facts / a well-founded fear
senses.example: A lasting friendship is [[founded]] on trust and respect rather than on shared hobbies.
senses.example_zh: 長久的友誼是以信任和尊重為基礎，而非共同的嗜好。
senses.note: 常用被動 be founded on

gsat.sentence: Benjamin Franklin, one of the [[Founding]] Fathers of the United States, was not only a great politician but also a highly accomplished scientist and inventor.

senses.en: to make an innocent person seem guilty
senses.pattern: be framed for / frame sb for a crime / claim to have been framed
senses.example: The detective discovered that the young clerk had been [[framed]] by the real thief.
senses.example_zh: 偵探發現那名年輕店員是被真正的小偷陷害的。

senses.en: to express something carefully in particular words
senses.pattern: frame a question / frame a reply / frame the issue as
senses.example: She [[framed]] her question carefully so that it would not embarrass the guest speaker.
senses.example_zh: 她小心斟酌提問的措辭，以免讓演講來賓難堪。

senses.en: considering; taking something into account
senses.pattern: given the circumstances / given his age / given the fact that / given that
senses.example: [[Given]] the heavy rain, the school decided to cancel the outdoor concert this afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 鑑於雨勢很大，學校決定取消今天下午的戶外音樂會。

senses.en: particular; already fixed or stated
senses.pattern: at any given time / on any given day / a given period / a given situation
senses.example: At any [[given]] moment, thousands of planes are flying in the skies around the world.
senses.example_zh: 在任何一個特定的時刻，全球天空中都有數千架飛機在飛行。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前，不是「被給的」

gsat.sentence: But [[given]] that Christmas is just a few weeks away, here is a gift idea.
[[Given]] the variations in preferences, new studies have started to untangle the benefits and risks of horror movies.

senses.en: (of an amount of money) large
senses.pattern: a handsome profit / a handsome sum / a handsome salary / a handsome reward
senses.example: The farmer made a [[handsome]] profit by selling his organic strawberries directly to city customers online.
senses.example_zh: 這位農夫透過網路把有機草莓直接賣給都市顧客，賺了一筆可觀的利潤。

senses.en: (of a thing) attractive, well made, and impressive
senses.pattern: a handsome building / a handsome design / a handsome old house
senses.example: The city library is a [[handsome]] stone building that has stood by the river since 1920.
senses.example_zh: 市立圖書館是一棟氣派的石造建築，自 1920 年起就矗立在河邊。

gsat.sentence: Nine proposals were submitted, and the Irish-born architect James Hoban won the gold medal for his practical and [[handsome]] design.

senses.en: a large number of people or things
senses.pattern: a host of problems / a whole host of reasons / a host of options
senses.example: The new library offers a [[host]] of free activities for children during summer vacation.
senses.example_zh: 新圖書館在暑假期間為孩童提供許多免費活動。
senses.note: 用於 a host of＋複數名詞

senses.en: an animal or plant that a parasite lives on
senses.pattern: a host animal / a host cell / the parasite's host
senses.example: The parasite cannot survive for long once it leaves the body of its [[host]].
senses.example_zh: 這種寄生蟲一旦離開宿主的身體就無法存活太久。

senses.en: to provide the place and services for an event
senses.pattern: host the Olympics / host a conference / host a party
senses.example: Our school will [[host]] the national science fair for the first time next spring.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校明年春天將首度主辦全國科展。

gsat.sentence: The temple celebrated Mazu Festival by [[hosting]] ten days of lion dances, Taiwanese operas, and traditional hand puppet shows.
Bekoji will [[host]] an international long-distance competition.

senses.en: the quality of working hard
senses.pattern: a person of great industry / reward someone's industry / industry and thrift
senses.example: The teacher praised Kevin for his [[industry]], noting that he never missed a single assignment.
senses.example_zh: 老師稱讚凱文的勤奮，並提到他從未漏交任何一份作業。

senses.en: to find the exact position of something or someone
senses.pattern: locate the source / locate a missing person / locate the problem / be unable to locate
senses.example: Rescue teams used drones to [[locate]] two hikers who had been missing since Sunday.
senses.example_zh: 搜救隊利用無人機，找出兩名自週日起失蹤的登山客的位置。
senses.note: 「位於」須用被動 be located in

gsat.sentence: They cannot [[locate]] the landmarks while trying to navigate forests.

senses.en: to want something very much
senses.pattern: long for peace / long to see sb / long for sb to V
senses.example: After months at sea, the sailors [[longed]] for a hot meal and a warm bed.
senses.example_zh: 在海上待了幾個月後，水手們渴望一頓熱食和一張溫暖的床。

senses.en: the lowest level or point reached
senses.pattern: hit a record low / an all-time low / fall to a new low / highs and lows
senses.example: The country's birth rate fell to a record [[low]] last year, worrying many economists.
senses.example_zh: 該國的出生率去年創下新低紀錄，令許多經濟學家憂心。

senses.en: feeling sad and without energy
senses.pattern: feel low / be in low spirits / a low mood
senses.example: Whenever Mia feels [[low]], she calls her grandmother, who always knows how to cheer her up.
senses.example_zh: 每當米雅情緒低落時，就打電話給奶奶，奶奶總是知道怎麼讓她開心起來。

senses.en: to keep saying that something is true
senses.pattern: maintain that / maintain one's innocence / have always maintained that
senses.example: Despite the evidence against him, the driver [[maintained]] that he had not run the red light.
senses.example_zh: 儘管證據對他不利，那名駕駛仍堅稱自己沒有闖紅燈。

senses.en: to advertise and sell a product to the public
senses.pattern: market a product / be marketed as / be marketed to teenagers
senses.example: The drink is [[marketed]] as a healthy choice, though each bottle contains ten cubes of sugar.
senses.example_zh: 這款飲料被當成健康的選擇來行銷，但每瓶其實含有十顆方糖的糖量。

senses.en: the number of people who want to buy something
senses.pattern: a market for / a growing market / a ready market
senses.example: There is a growing [[market]] for electric scooters as more cities limit gas-powered vehicles downtown.
senses.example_zh: 隨著越來越多城市限制燃油車進入市中心，電動機車的需求日益成長。

gsat.sentence: 100% Fish is a big international enterprise [[marketing]] seafood products.
The hula hoop gained international popularity in the late 1950s, when a plastic version was successfully [[marketed]] by California’s Wham-O toy company.

senses.en: a set of proposals or services offered together
senses.pattern: an aid package / a benefits package / a package of measures / a package tour
senses.example: The government announced a [[package]] of measures to help small shops survive the recession.
senses.example_zh: 政府宣布了一整套方案，協助小商店度過經濟衰退。

senses.en: to present someone or something in an attractive way
senses.pattern: be packaged as / package A as B / cleverly packaged
senses.example: The old fishing village has been [[packaged]] as a romantic getaway for young couples.
senses.example_zh: 這座古老的漁村被包裝成年輕情侶的浪漫度假勝地。

gsat.sentence: This tour [[package]] is very appealing, and that one looks equally attractive. I don’t know which one to choose.

senses.en: to control an activity by making sure rules are followed
senses.pattern: police the internet / police the industry / police itself
senses.example: Online platforms are expected to [[police]] their own sites and remove harmful posts quickly.
senses.example_zh: 外界期待網路平台監督、管制自己的網站，並迅速移除有害貼文。

senses.en: to keep order in a place using police officers
senses.pattern: police the streets / police the area / police an event
senses.example: Extra officers were sent to [[police]] the streets around the stadium during the final match.
senses.example_zh: 決賽期間，額外的警力被派去維持體育場周邊街道的治安。

senses.en: of or for ordinary people in general
senses.pattern: popular culture / popular support / popular opinion
senses.example: The plan to close the library was dropped because it had little [[popular]] support.
senses.example_zh: 關閉圖書館的計畫因為幾乎得不到民眾的支持而作罷。

senses.en: (of a belief) shared by many people
senses.pattern: popular belief / a popular misconception / contrary to popular belief
senses.example: Contrary to [[popular]] belief, bats are not blind and can actually see quite well.
senses.example_zh: 與普遍的看法相反，蝙蝠並不瞎，其實視力相當好。

gsat.sentence: Before Moran arrived, Yellowstone in the [[popular]] imagination was a harsh, wild place with hot water and steam coming out of hellish holes in the ground.

senses.en: to think logically and reach a conclusion
senses.pattern: reason that / reason logically / the ability to reason
senses.example: The detective [[reasoned]] that the thief must have had a key, since no window was broken.
senses.example_zh: 偵探推論小偷一定有鑰匙，因為沒有任何一扇窗戶被打破。

senses.en: the ability to think and judge sensibly
senses.pattern: listen to reason / lose one's reason / within reason
senses.example: Fear can be stronger than [[reason]], which is why people panic even when they know they are safe.
senses.example_zh: 恐懼有時比理智更強大，這就是為什麼人們明知安全仍會驚慌。

gsat.sentence: Dognition’s test measures a dog’s intellect in several aspects—from empathy to memory to [[reasoning]] skills.

senses.en: to shock or shake a place or group of people
senses.pattern: be rocked by a scandal / rock the nation / an explosion rocked the city
senses.example: The small town was [[rocked]] by the news that its only hospital would close next month.
senses.example_zh: 唯一的醫院下個月將關閉的消息，震驚了這座小鎮。
senses.note: rock the boat＝惹麻煩、破壞現狀

senses.en: to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side
senses.pattern: rock a baby to sleep / rock back and forth / rock gently / a rocking chair
senses.example: The young father gently [[rocked]] the crying baby in his arms until she fell asleep.
senses.example_zh: 年輕的父親把哭泣的寶寶抱在懷裡輕輕搖晃，直到她睡著。

gsat.sentence: If you have ever been sick to your stomach on a [[rocking]] boat or a bumpy car ride, you know the discomfort of motion sickness.

senses.en: empty space that can be used for something
senses.pattern: make room for / take up room / leave room for / room for one more
senses.example: We moved the sofa against the wall to make [[room]] for the new bookshelf.
senses.example_zh: 我們把沙發移到牆邊，好騰出空間放新書架。
senses.note: 作此義時為不可數名詞

senses.en: the chance for something to happen or be done
senses.pattern: room for improvement / room for doubt / no room for error
senses.example: Your essay is well organized, but there is still [[room]] for improvement in grammar.
senses.example_zh: 你的作文組織得很好，但文法仍有改進的餘地。

senses.en: to meet a requirement, condition, or standard
senses.pattern: satisfy a requirement / satisfy the conditions / satisfy the criteria
senses.example: The new playground cannot open until it [[satisfies]] every safety standard set by the city government.
senses.example_zh: 新遊樂場必須符合市政府訂定的每一項安全標準，才能開放。

senses.en: to make someone certain that something is true
senses.pattern: satisfy sb that / satisfy oneself that / be satisfied that
senses.example: The inspector checked every room to [[satisfy]] herself that the building was safe for children.
senses.example_zh: 檢查員查看了每個房間，好使自己確信這棟建築對兒童是安全的。

senses.en: to be the time or place when something happens
senses.pattern: the year saw / the city has seen / see a rise in
senses.example: The past decade has [[seen]] a sharp rise in the number of people working from home.
senses.example_zh: 過去十年見證了居家工作人數的急遽增加。

senses.en: to make sure that something is done
senses.pattern: see that the door is locked / see to it that / see that everyone gets a copy
senses.example: Please [[see]] that all the windows are closed before you leave the classroom.
senses.example_zh: 離開教室前，請確保所有窗戶都已關好。
senses.note: 也作 see to it that …

senses.en: to have enough beds for a number of people
senses.pattern: sleep four / sleep up to six people / the tent sleeps two
senses.example: The mountain cabin [[sleeps]] eight, so it is perfect for our two families this summer.
senses.example_zh: 這間山中小木屋可供八人住宿，很適合我們兩家人今年夏天去住。

senses.en: to have a bad or unpleasant smell
senses.pattern: begin to smell / your feet smell / the trash smells
senses.example: Take the garbage out before you leave, or the whole kitchen will [[smell]] by tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 出門前把垃圾拿出去，不然到明天早上整個廚房都會發臭。
senses.note: 後面不接形容詞時即指「有臭味」

senses.en: to sense that something is wrong or about to happen
senses.pattern: smell trouble / smell danger / smell a rat
senses.example: The experienced reporter [[smelled]] trouble as soon as the manager refused to answer any questions.
senses.example_zh: 那位經驗老到的記者一見經理拒絕回答任何問題，就察覺出事情不對勁。
senses.note: smell a rat＝覺得事有蹊蹺

senses.en: to come into someone's mind; to give an impression
senses.pattern: it strikes sb that… / strike sb as odd / be struck by sth
senses.example: What [[struck]] me most about the village was how friendly everyone was.
senses.example_zh: 這個村莊給我印象最深的，是每個人都非常友善。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 struck

senses.en: (of disaster or illness) to happen suddenly and harmfully
senses.pattern: disaster strikes / tragedy struck / when the earthquake struck
senses.example: When the earthquake [[struck]], most of the villagers were still asleep in their beds.
senses.example_zh: 地震侵襲時，大多數村民還在床上熟睡。

senses.en: a period of refusing to work as a protest
senses.pattern: go on strike / be on strike / a general strike
senses.example: Nurses at the hospital voted to go on [[strike]] unless more staff were hired by June.
senses.example_zh: 這家醫院的護理師投票決定，除非六月前增聘人手，否則就要罷工。

gsat.sentence: It can [[strike]] suddenly, progressing from a feeling of uneasiness to a cold sweat.
It suddenly [[struck]] me that I had to get to the airport to meet a friend.

senses.en: a person or animal used in an experiment
senses.pattern: test subjects / human subjects / subjects in the study
senses.example: Each [[subject]] in the sleep study wore a small device that recorded brain activity overnight.
senses.example_zh: 這項睡眠研究中的每位受試者都配戴一個小型裝置，整夜記錄腦部活動。
senses.note: 也指「臣民」，如 the king's subjects

senses.en: likely to be affected by; depending on
senses.pattern: be subject to change / be subject to delays / be subject to approval
senses.example: Ferry times are [[subject]] to change in bad weather, so check the website before leaving.
senses.example_zh: 天候不佳時，渡輪時刻易受影響而變動，所以出發前請先查看網站。

senses.en: to make someone or something experience something unpleasant
senses.pattern: subject sb to / be subjected to criticism / be subjected to tests / be subjected to pressure
senses.example: New helmets are [[subjected]] to dozens of crash tests before they can be sold.
senses.example_zh: 新安全帽在販售前，必須先經歷數十次撞擊測試。

gsat.sentence: Zebrafish, named for their characteristic stripes, have been a popular test [[subject]] for researchers.
When [[subjected]] to repeated pressurization high in the sky, the four corners on a square window may spell disaster.

senses.en: formal discussions between groups or governments
senses.pattern: peace talks / trade talks / hold talks with / talks break down
senses.example: Pay [[talks]] between the airline and its pilots broke down after only two days.
senses.example_zh: 航空公司與機師之間的薪資談判才進行兩天就破裂了。

senses.en: a speech or informal lecture on a subject
senses.pattern: give a talk on / attend a talk / a talk about
senses.example: A retired astronaut will give a [[talk]] on life in space at our school next Friday.
senses.example_zh: 一位退休太空人下週五將到我們學校演講，談太空中的生活。

gsat.sentence: Clunes, in Australia, holds a monthly book [[talk]] that hosts authors to discuss their latest releases.

senses.en: (of food) soft and easy to cut or chew
senses.pattern: tender meat / tender beef / cook until tender / tender and juicy
senses.example: Cook the beef slowly for three hours until it is [[tender]] enough to cut with a spoon.
senses.example_zh: 把牛肉慢燉三小時，直到軟嫩得用湯匙就能切開。

senses.en: painful or sore when touched
senses.pattern: tender to the touch / a tender spot / feel tender / swollen and tender
senses.example: Two days after the fall, his ankle was still swollen and [[tender]] to the touch.
senses.example_zh: 跌倒兩天後，他的腳踝仍然腫脹，而且一碰就痛。

senses.en: holding a position at that time in the past
senses.pattern: the then president / the then mayor / her then boyfriend
senses.example: The bridge was opened in 1950 by the [[then]] mayor, who called it a symbol of hope.
senses.example_zh: 這座橋在一九五〇年由當時的市長主持啟用，他稱之為希望的象徵。
senses.note: 只用於名詞前，常與 the 連用

senses.en: pleasant and wanted, because it comes when needed
senses.pattern: a welcome change / a welcome relief / welcome news / a welcome break
senses.example: After weeks of burning heat, the afternoon rain brought a [[welcome]] relief to the whole city.
senses.example_zh: 連續幾週酷熱之後，午後這場雨為全市帶來可喜的涼意。

senses.en: to be pleased to accept an idea or change
senses.pattern: welcome the decision / welcome the change / welcome suggestions
senses.example: Most teachers [[welcomed]] the plan to reduce class sizes, saying it would help weaker students.
senses.example_zh: 多數教師樂於接受縮小班級人數的計畫，認為這對程度較弱的學生有幫助。

gsat.sentence: A casual clothes code is [[welcomed]] by young employees.

senses.en: to a great extent; by a long way
senses.pattern: well over an hour / well before sunrise / well ahead of schedule / well past midnight
senses.example: The concert ended [[well]] past midnight, so we had to take a taxi home.
senses.example_zh: 演唱會結束時早已遠遠過了午夜，我們只好搭計程車回家。
senses.note: 放在介系詞或副詞前加強語氣

senses.en: a deep hole in the ground for water or oil
senses.pattern: dig a well / an oil well / draw water from a well
senses.example: Villagers used to walk two kilometers every day to fetch water from the [[well]].
senses.example_zh: 村民以前每天要走兩公里到井邊打水。

senses.en: (of liquid or feeling) to rise to the surface
senses.pattern: tears well up / well up in one's eyes / anger wells up
senses.example: Tears [[welled]] up in her eyes as she read the letter from her late grandmother.
senses.example_zh: 她讀著已故祖母寫的信，淚水不禁湧出。
senses.note: 常與 up 連用：well up

gsat.sentence: At that point, it might be [[well]] past the best moment to take in fluid.

senses.en: a unit of length equal to three feet
senses.pattern: a few yards away / a hundred yards / a yard of cloth
senses.example: The swimmer was only a few [[yards]] from the shore when the lifeguard reached her.
senses.example_zh: 救生員趕到時，那名泳者離岸邊只有幾碼遠。
senses.note: 一碼為三英尺，約 0.91 公尺

senses.en: an area of land used for a particular kind of work
senses.pattern: a lumber yard / a rail yard / a builder's yard
senses.example: Old ships are taken apart in a large [[yard]] by the harbor, and their steel is sold for recycling.
senses.example_zh: 舊船在港邊的一座大型工場裡被拆解，鋼材則賣去回收。

quiz.stem: By selling her design to a technology company, the young inventor earned a ______ sum of money, enough to pay for four years of college.
quiz.explain_zh: handsome＝（金額）可觀的。她賣出設計，賺到一筆足以付四年大學學費的可觀金額。

quiz.stem: The train drivers' ______ over low pay has entered its second week, leaving commuters with no choice but to drive or take crowded buses.
quiz.explain_zh: strike＝罷工。火車司機因低薪罷工已進入第二週，通勤族只能開車或擠公車。

quiz.stem: After twenty years as a doctor in the city, Dr. Chen decided to ______ a charity that offers free eye care to children in remote villages.
quiz.explain_zh: found＝創立（原形動詞）。陳醫師決定創立慈善機構，為偏鄉孩童提供免費眼科照護。

quiz.stem: Mr. Chang started as a factory cleaner, but through thirty years of ______ and careful saving, he eventually owned three restaurants.
quiz.explain_zh: industry＝勤勉。張先生靠三十年的勤奮與儲蓄，從清潔工變成三家餐廳的老闆。

quiz.stem: Only applicants who ______ all the requirements listed on the website, including having a valid driver's license, will be invited to an interview.
quiz.explain_zh: satisfy＝符合（條件）。只有符合網站所列全部條件的應徵者才會受邀面試。

quiz.stem: Seen from the airplane window, the green valley was ______ with hundreds of small white houses, each surrounded by its own fruit trees.
quiz.explain_zh: dot＝散布於、點綴。從機窗往下看，翠綠的山谷中散布著數百間小白屋。

quiz.stem: Studies have linked a lack of sleep to a ______ of health problems, including weight gain, poor memory, and heart disease.
quiz.explain_zh: host＝大量、許多。睡眠不足與許多健康問題有關。

quiz.stem: Thanks to the GPS tracker on its collar, the family was able to ______ their lost dog within just a few hours.
quiz.explain_zh: locate＝找出…的位置。靠著項圈上的定位器，這家人幾小時內就找到走失的狗。

quiz.stem: Although three classmates said they had seen him copying answers, Kevin still ______ that he had completed the test entirely on his own.
quiz.explain_zh: maintain＝堅稱。雖有同學指證他抄答案，凱文仍堅稱考卷是自己獨力完成的。

quiz.stem: Students who read widely in English tend to have a clear ______ over their classmates when it comes to writing essays.
quiz.explain_zh: edge＝優勢。廣泛閱讀英文的學生寫作文時比同學更占優勢。
